## Why it matters

This open-access collection assembles newspapers from across Southeast Asia, including titles from Myanmar, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam.

It is useful for tracing colonial rule, war, decolonization, and early independence through multilingual press coverage from the late nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
